  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os
base='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484952/attempts/d113ac7d3c8446a89f045c03b3a31b6a/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(base,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Divider rows and columns are solid lines in the background color.
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == bg for v in grid[r]) and len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == bg for r in range(h))]
    def segments(n, cuts):
        bounds = [-1] + cuts + [n]
        return [(bounds[i]+1, bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(bounds)-1)]
    rs, cs = segments(h, sep_rows), segments(w, sep_cols)
    # Use the first tile containing non-background marks as the source.
    source = next(((a,b,c,d) for a,b in rs for c,d in cs if any(grid[r][x] != bg for r in range(a,b) for x in range(c,d))), None)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    a,b,c,d = source
    pattern = [[grid[r][x] for x in range(c,d)] for r in range(a,b)]
    for y0,y1 in rs:
        for x0,x1 in cs:
            for i in range(y1-y0):
                for j in range(x1-x0):
                    out[y0+i][x0+j] = pattern[i][j]
    return out
'''

print(out)

code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    uniform_rows = [(r, grid[r][0]) for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    uniform_cols = [(c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    # The repeated full-width and full-height lines mark the tile boundaries.
    sep_color = next(v for r,v in uniform_rows if sum(x == v for _,x in uniform_rows) >= 2)
    sep_rows = [r for r,v in uniform_rows if v == sep_color]
    sep_cols = [c for c,v in uniform_cols if v == sep_color]
    def segments(n,cuts):
        bounds=[-1]+cuts+[n]
        return [(bounds[i]+1,bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(bounds)-1)]
    rs,cs=segments(h,sep_rows),segments(w,sep_cols)
    bg=next(grid[r][c] for a,b in rs for x,y in cs for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y) if grid[r][c] != sep_color)
    source=next((a,b,x,y) for a,b in rs for x,y in cs if any(grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != sep_color for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y)))
    a,b,x,y=source
    pattern=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(x,y)] for r in range(a,b)]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1 in rs:
        for c0,c1 in cs:
            for i in range(r1-r0):
                for j in range(c1-c0): out[r0+i][c0+j]=pattern[i][j]
    return out
